entry_route.value: Applicants without a master's degree can apply; those with one are assessed with extra weight on secondary criteria.
entry_route.quote: When assessing applicants with a Master’s degree, more weight is placed on the secondary criteria and additional aspects than for applicants without a Master’s degree.
